tools.summary: 工作流命名 is pure metadata: it names the run and must feed a real node.
steps: Put 工作流命名 at the head of the canvas (no incoming wire).
Type the run name; a blank name is refused before the run and in history grouping.
Wire it into the node whose work the name describes.
failures: An incoming wire: refused with engine.name_not_head.
No outgoing wire: refused with engine.name_no_downstream.

tools.summary: 文件上传 turns one stored dataset into the same row table a crawl produces. Downstream nodes never know the difference; the dataset id is the binding.
steps: Upload or paste a file in the data panel and note its dataset id.
Create 文件上传 and pick the dataset.
Wire it into 清洗/分词/分析 as if it were a crawl.
failures: No dataset_id: refused with engine.upload_no_file before the run.
The dataset was deleted and no name/row-count replacement exists: the executor refuses instead of returning [].

tools.summary: 分词 turns one text column into a word table: word/frequency pairs, bare words, or a single space-joined line. The upstream rows are the corpus; the node never reads a file itself.
steps: Wire a node that produces text rows into 分词.
Pick the text column and an output mode.
For word_freq, optionally cap the table with top_n (blank means the executor default).
failures: No text column configured: refuses before the run with engine.tokenize_no_column.
The column is absent from the upstream table: the executor names the column and the columns it saw.
No upstream rows: the executor refuses instead of settling an empty table DONE.

tools.summary: PDF 编译 collects the LaTeX emitted by visualize parents and compiles one document. It reads parent artifacts, not rows, and refuses an empty source instead of producing a blank PDF.
steps: Turn on 输出 LaTeX and/or LaTeX 表格 on every visualize parent.
Wire those visualize nodes into PDF 编译.
Wire the compile node into 保存 when the PDF needs a user-chosen filename.
failures: A parent is not a visualize node: engine.compile_bad_parent names it.
A visualize parent has both LaTeX boxes off: engine.compile_source_both_off names it.

tools.summary: 保存 merges every incoming table into one file, or saves a PDF from visualize/compile parents. Column sets must match; the executor refuses a merge rather than exporting only the first table.
steps: Wire one or more table producers into 保存 for a tabular export.
For a PDF, choose format=pdf (or a .pdf filename) and wire visualize/compile parents only.
Set the filename; the exporter appends the format extension when it is missing.
failures: A PDF save mixed with table parents: engine.output_pdf_mixed.
A PDF save with no visualize/compile parent: engine.output_pdf_only_pdfable.
Both a visualize and a compile PDF source: engine.output_pdf_two_sources.
A table save fed only by a PDF source: engine.output_needs_pdf.
